hooks.command: f=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const p=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';process.stdout.write(p)}catch(e){}})"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx eslint --fix "$f";; esac 2>/dev/null || true

cmd=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'')}catch(e){}})"); case "$cmd" in *"git add"*|*"git commit"*) hits=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.xlsx$|\.xls$|(^|/)exports?/|(^|/)uploads?/" || true); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "Fichiers sensibles potentiellement stages (export Excel/CSV, dossier uploads/exports niche) - verifie avant de committer:\\n%s"}' "$(echo "$hits" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr '\n' ';')"; fi ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true
